notes.title: Playable Build at Taipei Gaming Show 2024
notes.content:
Hello!

We’re happy to announce that Drowned Lake is participating in the [b]Taipei Gaming Show 2024 from Jan 25th to 28th[/b]! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dvnd4ew.gif[/img]

If you’re visiting the event, [b]stop by our CRITICAL REFLEX booth A01, near exit N to play the first-ever public build of the game[/b].

Don’t forget — Taipei Gaming Show 2024, booth A01, near exit N!

See you there!

You should also consider joining CR Channel Discord — we’re holding various themed activities tied to Drowned Lake as well as other games, host movie nights based on recommendations by Monumental Studio and, of course, post teasers and updates about Drowned Lake!

notes.title: DROWNED LAKE: A Chilling Horror Fishing Adventure
notes.content:
[list] 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4tGhPKn.gif[/img]
[/list]

[i]“Breaking News: Unexplained disappearance in the Mata Atlântica sparks fear in surrounding communities
A student has been reported missing in the Atlantic Forest. We continue to receive reports of strange noises and sightings in the vicinity as search parties comb the area. Authorities urge citizens to avoid causing excessive noise and exercise extreme caution in the areas surrounding the lake!”[/i]

[h1]Introducing: DROWNED LAKE [/h1]

We’re excited to officially announce the next project by Monumental Collab —  [b]Drowned Lake[/b]!

[previewyoutube=w9SHWqIj45A;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Venture into the depths of the Drowned Lake, a place shrouded in mystery and fear, where the line between reality and legend blurs.[/b]

Dive into the murky depths of Brazil’s Mata Atlântica and unravel the mystery surrounding the missing student. Embark on a chilling journey that seamlessly blends first-person exploration, investigative puzzles, and suspenseful fishing mechanics. Gather clues, solve puzzles, and cast your line into the murky waters, but be wary of the dangers that lurk beneath the surface.
[list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/36TKuWE.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Key Features[/h3]

[list]
[*] Immerse yourself in a non-linear horror story told from three perspectives. 
[*] Explore the dark secrets of the Drowned Lake through a variety of gameplay mechanics. 
[*] Face the consequences of your actions as you disturb the tranquility of the forest. 
[*] Experience a chilling tale inspired by Brazilian folklore. 
[*] Navigate narrow passages and solve intricate puzzles in first-person mode, and more!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zyxnYe7.gif[/img]
[h3]               Consider adding Drowned Lake to your wishlist![/h3]
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/2601540/DROWNED_LAKE

—————————————————————

[h3]To commemorate the announcement of [b]Drowned Lake[/b], we launched a free update for our previous short analog horror game set in the same universe of COMUNITV — [b]TELEFORUM[/b]. [/h3]

Be sure to check it out as it bridges the gaps between the two games and will reward the most attentive players with more clues about the nature of both.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186570/TELEFORUM/

[i]And the whispers of the waves carry our secrets into the depths, until we meet again.[/i]


You should also consider joining CR Channel Discord — we’re holding various themed activities tied to Drowned Lake as well as other games, host movie nights based on recommendations by Monumental Studio and, of course, post teasers and updates about Drowned Lake!
